page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.g6t.26xlarge is an enhanced general-purpose virtual machine provisioned on the KVM hypervisor. The instance is powered by an x86_64 Intel Xeon 8269CY processor clocked at a base frequency of 2.5 GHz. It features 104 dedicated vCPUs alongside 384.0 GB of system memory, providing approximately 3.69 GB of RAM per vCPU.

The instance does not include local disk storage, necessitating the attachment of network-attached block storage for operating system images and persistent application data. Network connectivity is supported by a 32 Gbps baseline network bandwidth, and the server includes zero complimentary public IPv4 addresses. Hardware acceleration is absent, with no integrated GPU resources.

With a balanced allocation between compute cores and memory capacity, the instance targets high-density workloads requiring substantial multi-threaded processing. Suitable workloads include enterprise application tiers, distributed data processing, continuous integration build farms, and high-throughput web serving environments relying on decoupled storage architectures.
description: Alibaba Cloud ecs.g6t.26xlarge is an enhanced enterprise instance type built on the KVM hypervisor and x86_64 architecture. Powered by a 2.5 GHz Intel Xeon 8269CY processor, it supplies 104 dedicated vCPUs and 384.0 GB of memory, which translates to 3.69 GB of RAM per virtual core. The platform includes no onboard local storage, depending entirely on external network-attached volumes for data retention and operating system hosting. It provides a baseline network throughput of 32 Gbps, while including zero complimentary public IPv4 addresses and zero discrete GPUs. The balanced CPU-to-memory ratio accommodates parallelized operations without over-indexing on memory or compute in isolation. Consequently, the instance is structured to handle scale-out enterprise workloads, continuous integration and build pipelines, batch data processing, and large web application clusters requiring robust network capabilities and high core density.
